explication: CodeIsland is a multi-platform AI coding-agent activity monitor, centered on a macOS notch interface. Agent hooks and session watchers report activity; the app normalizes and tracks sessions, presents status and approval/question prompts, and lets users respond or jump back to the working terminal. The README also documents remote hosts, phone/watch companions, ESP32, notifications, and webhook forwarding. The map reflects documented capabilities and sampled entry points; unsampled subsystem wiring is intentionally left out where ownership is unclear.
